cards.ex: Even though it wasn't his fault, he decided to shoulder the blame to protect his friend.
cards.exUz: Garchi uning aybi bo'lmasa ham, u do'stini himoya qilish uchun aybni bo'yniga olishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning xatosi yoki muammosi uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olmoq.

cards.ex: The manager always tries to pass the buck when something goes wrong.
cards.exUz: Boshliq doimo biror narsa noto'g'ri bo'lsa, javobgarlikni boshqalarga o'tkazishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Javobgarlikni boshqa birovga yuklamoq, o'zidan soqit qilmoq.

cards.ex: She took responsibility for her mistake and apologized to everyone affected.
cards.exUz: U o'z xatosi uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga oldi va ta'sirlanganlarning barchasidan uzr so'radi.
cards.uzDef: Qilgan ishi uchun javobgar bo'lishni tan olmoq.

cards.ex: We need to hold the company accountable for the environmental damage.
cards.exUz: Biz kompaniyani atrof-muhitga yetkazilgan zarar uchun javobgar qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Birovni o'z harakatlari uchun javob berishga majburlamoq.

cards.ex: I think the bad weather is to blame for the flight delays.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, yomon ob-havo reyslardagi kechikishlarga sababchi.
cards.uzDef: Biror yomon narsa sodir bo'lishiga sababchi bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He finally owned up to breaking the vase.
cards.exUz: U nihoyat vazani sindirganini tan oldi.
cards.uzDef: Xato yoki noto'g'ri ishni tan olmoq.

cards.ex: He lied to the police, but somehow he got off scot-free.
cards.exUz: U politsiyaga yolg'on gapirdi, lekin qandaydir tarzda jazodan qutulib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon ish qilgan bo'lsada, jazodan qutulib qolmoq.

cards.ex: You will have to answer for your actions sooner or later.
cards.exUz: Erta yoki kech siz o'z harakatlaringiz uchun javob berishingizga to'g'ri keladi.
cards.uzDef: Birovning xatti-harakatlari uchun javob berishga majbur bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Don't point the finger at me! I wasn't even there.
cards.exUz: Menga aybni ag'darmang! Men u yerda ham yo'q edim.
cards.uzDef: Birovni ayblamoq, aybni boshqaga yuklamoq.

cards.ex: My business partner ran off, and I was left holding the bag.
cards.exUz: Mening biznes sherigim qochib ketdi va men yomon vaziyatda yolg'iz qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Yomon vaziyatda yolg'iz qolmoq, aybni o'z zimmasiga olmoq.

cards.ex: Just fess up! We know you did it.
cards.exUz: Shunchaki tan oling! Buni siz qilganingizni bilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror yomon ishni tan olmoq (ko'pincha norasmiy).

cards.ex: He knew he was wrong, so he had to face the music.
cards.exUz: U noto'g'ri ekanligini bilardi, shuning uchun jazoni qabul qilishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Xatolar oqibatlarini qabul qilishga tayyor bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: I knew I was in the wrong, so I apologized immediately.
cards.exUz: Men noto'g'ri ekanligimni bildim, shuning uchun darhol uzr so'radim.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ish qilgan, xato qilgan.

cards.ex: The burden of proof is on the prosecution to prove the defendant is guilty.
cards.exUz: Ayblanuvchining aybdorligini isbotlash majburiyati prokuraturaga yuklatilgan.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsani isbotlash uchun javobgarlik.

cards.ex: His negligence caused the accident.
cards.exUz: Uning beparvoligi baxtsiz hodisaga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: E'tiborsizlik tufayli zarar yetkazish.

cards.ex: The soldier was charged with dereliction of duty.
cards.exUz: Askarga o'z vazifasini bajarmaganlik aybi qo'yildi.
cards.uzDef: O'z vazifasini bajarishdan bosh tortish.

cards.ex: The other driver was clearly at fault in the accident.
cards.exUz: Hodisada boshqa haydovchi aniq aybdor edi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ish qilgan, aybdor bo'lgan.

cards.ex: He became a scapegoat for the company's financial problems.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyaning moliyaviy muammolari uchun qurbonlik qo'yiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarning xatolari uchun ayblanadigan odam.

cards.ex: The company was held liable for the worker's injuries.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya ishchining jarohatlari uchun javobgar deb topildi.
cards.uzDef: Qonun bo'yicha javobgar deb e'lon qilinmoq.

cards.ex: My boss had to take the heat from the clients after the project failed.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchraganidan so'ng, boshlig'im mijozlardan zarbani o'ziga olishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Tanqidni yoki aybni o'ziga olmoq.

cards.ex: Whether he keeps his job hangs on his performance this quarter.
cards.exUz: Uning ishini saqlab qolishi shu chorakdagi faoliyatiga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsa boshqa narsaga bog'liq bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: He always tries to dodge responsibility when things go wrong.
cards.exUz: U doimo ishlar noto'g'ri ketganda javobgarlikdan qochishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Javobgarlikdan qochishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: She tried to lay the blame on her assistant, but no one believed her.
cards.exUz: U aybni yordamchisiga yuklashga harakat qildi, lekin hech kim unga ishonmadi.
cards.uzDef: Birovni ayblamoq, aybni boshqaga yuklamoq.

cards.ex: You can swim in the river, but it's at your own peril.
cards.exUz: Daryoda suzishingiz mumkin, lekin bu o'z xavfingizda.
cards.uzDef: Agar shunday qilsangiz, oqibatlar uchun o'zingiz javobgarsiz.

cards.ex: The driver was held responsible for the accident.
cards.exUz: Haydovchi hodisa uchun javobgar deb topildi.
cards.uzDef: Qilgan ishi uchun javobgar bo'lgan.

cards.ex: He wanted to make amends for his mistakes.
cards.exUz: U o'z xatolariga tovon to'lamoqchi edi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri ish uchun tovon to'lamoq, tuzatmoq.

cards.ex: I've explained it to you, now it's on you to finish the work.
cards.exUz: Men sizga tushuntirdim, endi ishni tugatish sizga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Biron narsa uchun siz javobgarsiz, siz qilishingiz kerak.

cards.ex: If anything goes wrong, it's on my head.
cards.exUz: Agar biror narsa noto'g'ri bo'lsa, bu mening javobgarligimda.
cards.uzDef: Birov uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olmoq.

cards.ex: The government has come under fire for its handling of the crisis.
cards.exUz: Hukumat inqirozga qarshi choralar ko'rgani uchun tanqidga uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Katta tanqid ostida qolmoq.

cards.ex: He had to answer charges of fraud in court.
cards.exUz: U sudga firibgarlik aybiga javob berishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy ayblovga javob berish, himoyalanish.
